items.summary: Automotive group GM Group, a dealer of 10 automotive brands, has officially opened a new Renault dealership, Favorit Auto Kyiv, on the Velyka Kiltseva Road, covering an area of 4,850 square meters, according to a press release from importer Renault Ukraine.

items.title: Romania calls on NATO to help repel Russian hybrid attacks
items.summary: Romanian Foreign Minister Dan Neculăescu has called on NATO to adopt joint measures against Russian hybrid threats – including cyberattacks, disinformation and Black Sea incidents – and warned that the Black Sea is becoming a weak spot in European security.
